chapter: Orchestra people and Xavier chamber concerts
title: Walter Herbert and the New Orleans opera orchestra
summary: Herbert conducted and effectively managed the New Orleans opera for years, and Mazzari credits him for the city's opera company.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: Well, you asked me to ask you about Walter Herbert, who is he?

Walter Herbert? Oh, he conducted the opera orchestra here in New Orleans for many years. In fact, he was practically the business manager too. And when they hardly had any money, you know, I think he managed it very well. And if we have an opera orchestra in New Orleans, an opera company in New Orleans today, I think he's to thank for it. Because of his iron fist was money. And he was, and a fine orchestra conductor too. Throw cue at musicians, throw cues at singers, everything. He was very good. I liked him as an opera conductor.
